notes.title: Ver1.04
notes.notes: Some of the enemy's lines were modified to make it easier to understand the situation in which the protagonist is placed.

notes.title: Ver1.03
notes.notes: Fixed enemy behavior so that they do not suddenly turn back.

notes.title: Ver1.02
notes.notes: Fixed so that when hiding in a closet while being chased by an enemy, if the enemy is within a certain distance, the closet will open even if the enemy cannot see the player.

notes.title: Ver1.01
notes.notes: Changed specifications to prevent the monster from opening the closet during the search. (If they see you hiding in the closet while being chased, they will open the closet)

notes.title: 【Escape from the Cannibal Family】 Scheduled for release on October 23, 2024!
notes.notes:
【Escape from the Cannibal Family】 is scheduled to be released on October 23, 2024 Japan time!
The demo version is still available, so please try it out.

The full version will have a larger map to explore, different endings, and many game over scenes where the main girl is cooked!

We also allow distribution, so please refer to the guidelines on our store page for more information before playing.
